claim: On both stdio and Streamable HTTP, `_request_metadata` forwards every request `_meta` key except the progress-token key (`progressToken` or `progress_token`) and keys starting with `io.modelcontextprotocol/`. An SDK-managed key outside that prefix, other than the progress token, is forwarded.
